fields.description: UH By Ellington, launched as Upper House, is a two-tower apartment development in Jumeirah Lakes Towers with studios through three-bedroom homes and shared creative, social and fitness facilities.

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact own UH body and primary January 2023 Upper House release checked. Two towers retained as one protected record; no unrelated Eltiera Views PDF used.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page establishes Jumeirah Lakes Towers and project context near Jumeirah Islands; no assumed walk-time claim.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own Studio–3 mix corroborated by phase-specific West and East guides. Each original count 34+215+85+29+14=377; combined754 matches launch.
reviewCoverage.areas: Own 43-page brochure and broker 29-page West plans read. Actual West plan panels9/11/23/27/28 and own brochure32/33/38/39/41 visually checked across all families. West examples not assigned to East units.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own project-specific facilities used; no current operating-service guarantee inferred.
reviewCoverage.pricing: PF UH West exact launch reference 750,828 used with phase and historical qualifier; no common current minimum for both towers.
reviewCoverage.payment: No branded payment schedule found in own brochure or either phase brief, and public microsite TLS failed. PF 20/50/30 shown only as West portal reference; headline null.
reviewCoverage.handover: West brief actual page 6 anticipates Q1 2026; East page 6 omits date. January 2023 primary launch projected beginning 2026; dates elapsed, no actual handover confirmation.
reviewCoverage.documents: Working own 43-page brochure plus broker West 56-page / East 57-page briefs and 29-page West plans obtained. Numeric phase panels 6/7 visually checked. Search-indexed Remapp file claiming UH was actually Eltiera Views and excluded.

overview: Two towers combine homes with shared spaces for exercise, music, art and everyday social life.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai. Confirm the selected tower, floor, access route and orientation.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s UH West guide lists AED 750,828 at launch. This historical West-tower reference does not establish current stock or an East-tower quotation.
research.handoverNote: The original West guide anticipates Q1 2026; East’s configuration page gives no date. The January 2023 launch projected early 2026. No current developer handover confirmation was retrieved.
research.paymentNote: The table is Property Finder’s UH West 20/50/30 reference only. A phase-specific developer payment document was not retrieved; request the selected unit’s signed schedule.

facts.label: Original tower counts
facts.value: Each launch guide counts 377 homes; the combined 754 is an original development count, not remaining stock.

facts.label: Tower differences
facts.value: East’s configuration includes two basement levels; West’s summary does not. Their size summaries differ, so units are not interchangeable.
